sn22.76:2.4: The nine “abodes of sentient beings” (_sattāvāsā_) are listed at ([an9.24](). The “pinnacle of existence” (_bhavagga_), also mentioned in passing at [an4.75:1.3](), is said at [vb18:209.3]() and [kv3.12:22.4]() to be the dimension of neither perception nor non-perception.
sn22.76:8.1: The “ten qualities of an adept” are the eight path factors plus right knowledge and right freedom ([an10.112]()).
